secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for any OpenAI-compatible AI provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Ollama/LM Studio, Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ...). The app runs without it, but chat replies fail with a clear message until it is set.

secrets.name: AI_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Base URL of the provider's OpenAI-compatible API. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Examples: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai

secrets.name: AI_MODEL
secrets.description: Optional. Default model id sent to the provider. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini. Examples: openai/gpt-4o-mini (OpenRouter), llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Groq), gemini-2.5-flash (Google OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
